The Local Government units of disease-infected

Southern Leyte and Leyte provinces are hereby encouraged to strictly implement

All executive orders or issuances, or portions thereof, which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked, amended or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
